caption: The drawing depicts a hand saw, specifically a type of frame saw or bow saw with a distinctive curved metal frame and a toothed blade. The saw blade is attached to the lower part of the reddish-brown metal frame and features fine, sharp teeth. The saw's right end has a cylindrical wooden handle, colored in shades of brown with a brass ferrule near the point where it connects to the metal frame. The handle has a rounded, slightly bulbous shape. On the left side of the saw, the metal frame terminates in a small, adjustable clamp with a wing nut, also rendered in brown tones, which secures the blade in place. The background of the drawing is plain and beige, with slight texture and some faint spotting. The composition centers the saw horizontally within the image, with no other objects present.
title: Hack Saw
